people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
translations.kjv: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
translations.asv: It is a continual burnt-offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
